scenes.title: 可数名词用 many / a few
scenes.lead: 可数名词有复数形式，比如 books, apples。
scenes.sentence: There are many books in the library.

scenes.title: 不可数名词用 much / a little
scenes.lead: 不可数名词没有复数，比如 water, milk。
scenes.sentence: There is a little water in the bottle.

scenes.title: 量词 + of 来计量
scenes.lead: 我们可以用 a cup of, a piece of 来计量不可数名词。
scenes.sentence: I drink a cup of milk every day.
